description.narrative: Founded in 2018, Patrimonio en Fideicomiso - Decreto Legislativo N°861, Título XI Fideicomiso de Titulización para Inversión en Renta de Bienes Raíces Fibra PRIME (Prime) is the first and largest Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) in Peru. It is focused on the acquisition, leasing, and management of real estate assets and is listed in the Lima Stock Exchange. IFC is considering providing a US$70 million senior secured financing package, including a secured IFC A Loan of up to US$40 million and a B/Parallel Loan of up to US$30 million, to support Primes 2024-2026 investment plan. This includes the acquisition of office assets, efficiency improvements to achieve green building certifications, and debt refinancing.

The Project is expected to provide increased access to high quality industrial space and office space. The Project is also expected to generate positive environmental effects through higher resource efficiency of green buildings. Beyond the Project, the investment will promote greater sustainability in Perus commercial property sector. This investment also has the potential to enhance competitiveness by supporting the growth of the leading REIT in the market.
